registration_phase: Before timing extraction, reference measurement or threshold selection
purpose: Software regression-budget calibration only; no biological or clinical validation
correctness_contract: Preserve every ingest/output/match/error/index/provenance assertion, the 10k 30-second guard, and the separate informational PRD 120/300-second targets. No real sample, genotype or reference bundle is used.

historical_ci.selection: All seven consecutive scheduled successful synthetic benchmark executions in this fixed completed window; no timing-based inclusion/exclusion
historical_ci.primary_metric: pytest --durations full call seconds for test_annotation_600k_timing; conservative upper bound for the narrower annotation timer; fixture setup is separate
historical_ci.runner: Existing GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest / Python 3.12 workflow; record available actual versions. Historical observations remain bound to their original source heads.

reference.selection: Three fresh-process full 600k synthetic module executions, serial, no profiling or warmup exclusion; retain every attempt and stop acceptance on any failure or invalid condition
reference.baseline_source: Exact public baseline head, filtered object checkout excluding both held-out individual genotype blobs
reference.allocation_note: Exclusive allocation reserves all CPUs on the selected CPU-only node; memory remains the finite 32-GiB request. Record full actual allocation and verify four physical affinity cores belong to it.
reference.load: No co-scheduled Slurm jobs on the exclusive allocation; record load, affinity, packages, source, storage, concurrency and peak memory around each run. Use a fresh process and fresh synthetic in-memory fixture each time.
reference.primary_metric: Annotation elapsed printed by the unchanged benchmark, captured in passed-test output; also record full call/setup and wall time separately

acceptance: All seven historical benchmark jobs and all three reference executions must be functionally successful, complete and valid under the declared conditions.
CI limit must be strictly below 3600 seconds; reference limit strictly below 1800 seconds.
Both limits must strictly exceed every observed conservative upper bound.
Each new limit must be no greater than twice its group median conservative observation, so a twofold observed-baseline scenario is rejected by the strict less-than guard.
CI limit must be at least the reference limit.
No post-hoc sample deletion, threshold loosening, assertion bypass or workflow-timeout substitution. If any condition fails, retain evidence and withhold the new limits.
selection_policy.workflow_pytest_minutes: CI limit / 60 + 15 (preserve existing fixed non-annotation margin)
selection_policy.workflow_job_minutes: pytest minutes + 15 (preserve existing fixed setup/cleanup margin)

validation_plan: Record a discriminating fast regression against the old limits, then pass it with calibrated limits through the same helper used by the actual 600k test.
Rerun the complete synthetic benchmark on the committed final head under both applicable budget modes without changing correctness assertions.
Run full affected backend/static/docs/workflow gates and the exact-head selected review route; main must pass all covering checks after merge.

sources.scope: Resource-allocation semantics, verified alongside installed Slurm 25.11.2 help

tool_fallback: Context7 monthly quota exceeded; installed CLI help and official Slurm documentation used, with no guessed library ID or account/settings change.
